h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bihar Sharif

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bihar Sharif

items.pText: Bihar Sharif is about 1,450 km from our factory in Vasai East, which makes it one of the longer road dispatches we plan. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, residential colonies, institutions and public gardens in Bihar Sharif and the rest of Nalanda district. Every piece is built in our own facility and sent by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

Because the equipment travels a long way, we put extra effort into planning before anything leaves the factory. We ask for the site size, the age group of the children and clear photos of the ground, then send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Once you approve the layout and the quote, the full order is made, packed and dispatched together.

richText.heading: Getting the site ready before the truck arrives

c: A long dispatch works best when the site is ready on the day the equipment reaches you. Clear the area, level it and finish any civil work, such as a raised base or a boundary wall, before we dispatch. If the equipment is to be grouted, the installation team will need the ground open for digging, so tell us about any trees, drains or cables in the area.
Check that a truck can reach the gate, or plan a short carry from the road. Lanes in the older parts of town can be narrow, and knowing this in advance saves time on installation day.

richText.heading: Heat, fog and wet ground in Nalanda district

c: South Bihar has hot, dry summers, a monsoon from June to September and cold winters with thick morning fog. Each season affects a playground differently. In summer, slides and decks facing the afternoon sun get hot, so place them where a building or trees give shade. During the rains, flat ground across the plains can stay waterlogged, which is why we suggest a slightly raised base with a drainage slope.
Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit this mix of weather. Wipe off the dew on foggy winter mornings before the first group of children starts playing.
For a school, the main need is equipment for several age groups on one ground. We keep toddler pieces such as
spring riders

apart from the larger climbing structures meant for older children. Residential colonies and municipal gardens usually start with a swing set, a slide and a see-saw. A multi play system can follow once the space is in regular use.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Bihar Sharif?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture everything at our Vasai factory and send it about 1,450 km by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India then sets it up on your site, self-standing or grouted.

items.q: How should we prepare the ground before installation?
items.a: Clear and level the area, finish any civil work and check that a vehicle can reach the site. If the equipment is to be grouted, keep the ground open for digging. We share these points in advance along with the layout drawing.

items.q: Can you supply equipment for a school with children of different ages?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the age groups and how many children use the ground at one time. We will suggest separate zones for younger and older children, each with its own safe play area on the drawing.

items.q: Who do we call for spare parts or repairs after installation?
items.a: Our after-sales team, on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty, and galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years.
